summary: Phase-1 MVP verified end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS covering health, OTP request/verify (incl. wrong-code 401), /worker/me, offers list + score-descending sort, accept (Shift created, wage matches job.dailyWage, headcount decremented), decline (offer -> DECLINED), full 12-state shift lifecycle from ACCEPTED through travel/arrive/check-in/start-work/break/resume/complete/check-out/close, geofence 422 for far check-in, illegal 422 for close-on-CLOSED, /shifts/active, /worker/earnings numeric fields, /notifications list + read-all, trust score present & in 0-100 range. Mobile UI: splash->login (phone-input, login-continue-button, dev-OTP-hint), OTP screen (otp-input pre-filled with 123456, otp-verify-button), home dashboard (home-availability-card, home-trust-card score=94, home-stat-shifts, home-stat-earnings), Jobs tab shows offer cards with offer-accept/offer-decline testIDs + MATCH % (94%, 69%, 51%), Shifts/Earnings/Profile tabs render clean, Trust card taps into /trust with score ring + attendance/acceptance/cancellations/avg-rating factor rows, profile-signout redirects to /login and clears session. No red screens, no JS errors. No deprecated Expo packages detected. Note: seed data was consumed by prior tests once; re-seeded via `npx tsx prisma/seed.ts` before final runs.

minor.issue: Response returns offer.status (not offer.state). Naming inconsistent with the ACCEPTED/DECLINED naming used elsewhere (e.g. Shift.state). Consider normalizing to `state` for API consistency.

issues: Bottom tab links render as <a role='tab'> without data-testid attributes (e.g. tab-home, tab-jobs, tab-shifts, tab-earnings, tab-profile). Tabs still work via role, but adding testID props to the Tabs.Screen options would improve testability.

action_items: OPTIONAL: normalize offer state field naming — server currently returns `status` on the decline response but `state` is used for shifts; unify to `state` for consumer clarity.
OPTIONAL: add data-testid props to bottom Tabs.Screen entries (tab-home/tab-jobs/tab-shifts/tab-earnings/tab-profile) to make future test authoring more robust.
Nothing blocking — Phase-1 MVP is ready. Re-seed with `cd /app/dispatch-platform/backend && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts` before demo if a previous run consumed Rajesh's offers.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is a thin FastAPI proxy that spawns tsx-watch node backend on 8002; on-startup handler auto-restarts node if it dies during requests — good resilience.

prisma schema + seed produce deterministic Chennai/Bengaluru geo coords used by dispatch scoring; distance calc appears to feed both `distanceKm` and score correctly (verified via sorted-desc assertion).
shift.engine correctly enforces the 12-state FSM: closing a CLOSED shift returns 422 INVALID_STATE as required.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL properly; no hardcoded URLs. All screens are wrapped in SafeAreaView with correct edges; TextInputs are inside KeyboardAvoidingView.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded via `cd /app/dispatch-platform/backend && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts` (idempotent seed script) to restore Rajesh's 3 pending offers after they were consumed by the lifecycle test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend proxy is stable. Node logs live at /var/log/supervisor/dispatch-backend.log. The lifecycle pytest consumes one of Rajesh Kumar's (+919020001000) offers each run — if `TestOffers` fails with 'No offers for either seeded worker', re-seed with `cd /app/dispatch-platform/backend && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts` before rerunning. Run pytest in serial mode with `-n 0` (pytest-xdist default breaks module-level shared state used by TestShiftLifecycle).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a minor API naming inconsistency (offer.status vs offer.state) worth normalizing later.
